recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future Pharmacy work group decision changes MedicationRequest lifecycle status semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-3021 asked for medication-prescription-status to add a draft code for prescription/order records that are not yet active, including works in progress, orders needing sign-off, narcotics needing counter-signature, and orders being evaluated by decision support before activation.
initial_application: No local git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-3021 was found. The early MedicationPrescription spreadsheet initially contained draft, commit 9cebb3da33e5 removed it with an explicit note that it would be added back later, and by commit abce09d8c1ed the MedicationPrescriptionStatus binding and code list again contained draft. Rename lineage then preserved the concept through MedicationOrder and MedicationRequest, including d75ee68d691c for medication-order-status and 7387b2894c02 for the MedicationRequest rename and status value set update.
additional_context: The current build scope is MedicationRequest rather than the retired MedicationPrescription name: source/fhir.ini has an active medicationrequest resource entry and records that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. Searches of Jira, Zulip, and Confluence found only FHIR-3021 and no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml lists draft on MedicationRequest.status and binds it required to ValueSet/medicationrequest-status, while source/medicationrequest/codesystem-medicationrequest-status.xml defines draft with semantics matching the Jira request.
